text: dsh-attention-reminder 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的提醒插件：宿主监听待处理的授权请求和用户问题，并由网页端轮询状态。它会在会话标题栏加入铃铛设置面板，在页面浮层显示等待处理的事项；新请求可触发一次合成提示音、窗口聚焦和浏览器系统通知。面板提供声音与弹窗的独立开关及测试提醒，最多显示三张卡片，其余以数量提示。适合希望及时发现 DSH 正在等待人工授权或回答的用户。开关状态保存在 DSH 插件数据目录；无需额外服务或密钥。

dsh-attention-reminder alerts DSH users when approvals or questions await an answer. The host tracks pending items as the page polls. A header panel controls sound and popups. New items can chime and appear as floating cards or browser notifications. Settings are saved locally; no API key needed.
DSH 等我点头授权工具时，能不能提醒我一下？
我想知道 agent 什么时候在等我回答问题。
Let me know when DSH is waiting for my approval or an answer.
dsh-attention-reminder 的功能「待处理提醒」：发现新的授权请求或用户问题时，可响起提示音、聚焦窗口并显示系统通知。网页浮层列出最多三项，超出部分显示数量。
dsh-attention-reminder 的功能「提醒控制面板」：点击会话标题栏的铃铛可分别切换声音和弹窗提醒，也能发送测试提醒；开关状态写入宿主插件数据目录并跨重启保留。

dsh-attention-reminder README · dsh-attention-reminder：Sound and on-screen alerts for DeepSeek Harness: when the agent needs **your approval** (an `approval/request`) or **an answer** (`ask_user_question`), the plugin strikes a short chime, raises the DSH window, and floats a card above the page.

Two independent toggles — **sound** and **popup** — both remembered across reloads and restarts.

dsh-attention-reminder README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:chenyuiyu/dsh-attention-reminder
```

On DSH Desktop, install it from **Settings → Plugins**. The plugin is plain JavaScript: no build step, no dependencies.

dsh-attention-reminder README · The two toggles：Both live behind the 🔔 button at the right end of the session header.

- **Sound** — one bell strike (WebAudio, ~0.5 s). Each new request chimes exactly once and never repeats; the card stays on screen until you answer it.
- **Popup** — `window.focus()` to put DSH in front, a floating card above the page naming what is waiting (up to 3 cards, the rest folded into “+N more”), and a system notification where the browser allows one.

dsh-attention-reminder README · The two toggles：The panel also has **Send a test reminder**, which travels the same path as a real alert.

Toggles are stored in `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-attention-reminder/state.json` (default `~/.dsh/plugin-data/...`).

dsh-attention-reminder README · How it works：- **Host half** ([index.js](index.js)) listens to the waterfall events `approval/request` and `user-questions/request` and keeps the unanswered ones in a bounded queue (24 entries). An entry leaves the queue when the promise returned by `next()` settles or the request's `AbortSignal` aborts. It only observes: every handler delegates with `return next()`, so approvals and questions behave exactly as before. The queue and the toggles are served as `GET/POST /api/attention-reminder` through `connection.fetch.register`.
- **Web half** ([client.js](client.js)) polls that route once a second and announces only ids it has not seen yet. Cards register into `shell.overlay`; the 🔔 panel into `conversation.session.header.utilities`.
dsh-attention-reminder README · How it works：Plugins have no host-to-page push channel, which is why the page polls; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-deja` uses the same HTTP route pattern.

dsh-attention-reminder README · Notes：- Audio starts after one interaction with the page — a browser rule, not this plugin. If DSH was just opened and an alert fires before you touched anything, one click on the page fixes it and the next alert is audible.
- `window.focus()` cannot always beat the Windows foreground lock; the floating card and the system notification still appear.
- The system notification needs the browser's notification permission, requested the first time you enable popup or press the test button (both are user gestures).
